sources.entry: piqueserver - Server for openspades, the first-person shooter in a destructible voxel world. (Clients) GPL-3.0 Python/C++

summary.one_liner: OpenSpades is an open-source, cross-platform client for the Ace of Spades 0.75 voxel first-person shooter that can connect to vanilla, pyspades, and pysnip servers.
summary.what_it_does: OpenSpades is a compatible client for Ace of Spades 0.75, the first-person shooter set in a destructible voxel world. According to the README, it can connect to vanilla, pyspades, and pysnip servers. It uses OpenGL and OpenAL for rendering and audio. The README describes it as open source and cross platform. Pre-built packages are available as a Snap and a Flatpak for Linux. Building from source is documented for Linux (Debian, Fedora, FreeBSD, other distros, and Nix Flakes), Windows with Visual Studio, and macOS with Ninja. The README does not describe the server-side software; the awesome-selfhosted listing places piqueserver under this entry.
use_cases: Playing Ace of Spades-compatible voxel shooter on Linux
Connecting to pyspades or pysnip game servers
Building a custom game client from source
Installing a game client via Snap or Flatpak
Playing a destructible voxel FPS on Windows or macOS
notable: Compatible with vanilla, pyspades, and pysnip servers
Pre-built Snap and Flatpak packages on Linux
Builds on Linux, FreeBSD, Windows (Visual Studio), and macOS
Optional download of non-free paks can be disabled via CMake flag
caveats: macOS builds need gcc 6 or newer (not clang) on 10.14 Mojave or earlier; universal builds are not supported yet
Windows audio needs extra DLLs copied in, and the non-free pak must be copied manually
Build instructions may be outdated, according to the README
